notes:
- New: Data2 & Data3 - right-click the chart > Add Symbol to confirm on a higher timeframe (e.g. 5-min with the 60-min trend), no lookahead. Data3 is Gold
- New: drawing toolbar - trend lines, rays, channels, Fibonacci, rectangles, text, Long/Short position with risk:reward, Measure; drag, resize and edit any drawing
- New: candle styles - Candlesticks, Hollow, Bars, Heikin Ashi; Volume candles for Gold
- New: left-click and hold a bar to inspect it
- Bar times now show the bar's CLOSE time, like TradeStation (Settings > General > Bar time to change)
- US stocks: 30/60-min bars start at 09:30 New York, scans run on the US clock
